verdict.rationale: Docusign documents a general way to send, sign and manage any agreement, with reusable shared templates and configurable workflows. Offer letters and confidentiality/IP agreements could plausibly run through this, but the evidence never names hiring or equity paperwork specifically. Missing for 10: explicit offer-letter, confidentiality/IP and option-grant templates or workflows, equity/cap-table handling for option grants, HR-system integrations, and independent corroboration for this use case.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, I can run hiring and equity paperwork — offer letters, confidentiality/IP agreements, and option grants — through the platform

citations.quote: Send, sign and manage all your agreements for free.
